Field notes
Four movable rods share a material allowance. Select a rod, move its hinge in 0.2 steps, and choose length 1.2, 1.8 or 2.4. Longer rods reach farther but have more rotational inertia. Numbered hinges must remain in order.
Release gives only the fixed starter an initial push. Gravity, an upright spring detent, and actual tip-to-side collision impulses determine which rods fall. A rod can miss over or under its neighbor, fall short, or fail to transfer enough motion.
The hanging bell at the far side must be struck. Three failed releases lose. Inspect the final angles and first-contact times; Earlier/Later replay frame shows the continuous simulation in 0.1-second steps. Raised shelves in later studies change contact heights.
